name: register_oncall_availability
description: register_oncall_availability: Register an employee's on-call availability for a date window, including any blackout dates within the window when they are unavailable. Returns a registration_id on success. Blackout dates must fall within the availability window or the request is rejected.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

unit_code.description: The unit for the on-call registration. Format: digits+letter-letters. Example: 4B-ICU

availability_start_date.description: The first day of the availability window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-06-01

availability_end_date.description: The last day of the availability window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-06-30

oncall_tier.description: The on-call tier: primary (first to be called) or backup (called if primary is unavailable)

blackout_dates.description: Dates within the availability window when the employee is unavailable, each in YYYY-MM-DD format. Pass an empty list [] if there are none.
